brief:
The identity of Israel's next leader remains uncertain, with neither major candidate positioned to shift policy toward prioritizing American interests, the Quincy Institute reported. The election outcome will shape regional dynamics and U.S. involvement in Middle Eastern affairs.

Both contenders have outlined positions that maintain current strategic alignments rather than realign priorities around American-first principles. The lack of a candidate offering such a reorientation signals continuity in Israeli-American relations regardless of electoral outcome.
title: Israel's next leader unclear as both candidates reject U.S.-first approach
